technique_name: Explain the differences between the IaaS, PaaS and SaaS cloud computing models.
description: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) is a cloud computing model where users access virtualized computing resources that are managed by a cloud provider. IaaS enables users to access, provision, and manage their own computing resources and handle the underlying infrastructure, such as servers, storage, and networks.
